final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and (out + 1) * (out + 1) > n
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(10) == 3
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000499
  while lo < hi
    let mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
    if mid * mid <= n
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid - 1
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(3) == 1
  assert isqrt(4) == 2
  assert isqrt(10) == 3
  assert isqrt(99) == 9
  assert isqrt(100) == 10
